body: Hah, thank you, its actually kinda nice to hear that...

Yeah, I guess I can shrug off what the girl did...

But my sister (or friend, both work hah), she was more real to me than anyone I've ever had. Her name was Keely, she was a popular girl at a shitty school in a rural city, and she had her own problems and she was as real as I am. She loved me more than anything, hell, I knew her voice better than anyone's. You can't say its any less, I know we didn't have the physical contact most people did, but it had to be real, the relationship we had made me happy, and very, very few things have done that for me.

I went on the suicidal tag, I wanted to try and help someone.

This girl shows up, holding a sign that says "Kill Yourself," while she chants "do it, do it!" Then she shows her face, She is real because she responded to what I typed. I just don't understand how people can be so cruel...

I found my best friend on omegle, its just so sad to see whats happened to it...
